thread:
Sam: Quick check — noticed GH Actions matrix is spawning multiple Atlantis plan runs for the same PR which creates duplicate plans and then ArgoCD ends up trying to sync the same change twice. Anyone seen this pattern recently?

Alex: Yep, saw it yesterday after we added the node-version matrix. GH creates separate workflow runs per matrix axis and our repo_dispatch-based atlantis trigger fires for each run.

Maria: That explains it. Our atlantis webhook expects exactly one incoming dispatch per PR. We added autoplan and atlantis.yaml looks normal, but multiple plans confuse the UI and can lead to parallel applies if someone hits apply on both. Example atlantis snippet: 
```yaml
version: 3
projects:
  - name: core
    dir: infra/core
    autoplan:
      when_modified: ["**/*.tf"]
      enabled: true
```

ci-bot: Logs from the last run: 
```
[2026-03-16T18:03:12Z] Received repo_dispatch event for PR #412 (matrix-axis: node-16)
[2026-03-16T18:03:12Z] Starting atlantis plan for repo redwood/infra
[2026-03-16T18:03:14Z] Received repo_dispatch event for PR #412 (matrix-axis: node-18)
[2026-03-16T18:03:14Z] Starting atlantis plan for repo redwood/infra
```

Jen: Two quick options: (1) Stop dispatching atlantis from each matrix job and instead dispatch once from a dedicated job that runs after the matrix (use needs: [matrix]) or (2) use GitHub Actions concurrency + a group keyed by PR number to collapse duplicate runs. Example concurrency for a single-run dispatch job:
```yaml
concurrency:
  group: pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
```
Or in the workflow, add a final job `atlantis-dispatch` with `needs: [build-matrix]` and `if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'` so it runs once.

Ravi: Another small tweak is to make the dispatch payload include matrix info and have atlantis ignore duplicate plans by checking `base_commit`. But that requires changes in atlantis-side hooks. Simpler to change GH Actions. Also consider setting Atlantis `apply_requirements` so accidental double applies are harder (e.g., require merge lock or approval).

Alex: Agreed on single-dispatch job. We already run a `matrix` job for tests; add `atlantis-dispatch` with `needs: matrix` and `runs-on: ubuntu-latest` and it will only run once per PR. Also add `concurrency` as Jen suggested in case someone re-triggers.

Sam: Thanks — I'll draft the GH Actions PR. Proposed minimal change: move the repo_dispatch step out of the `matrix` job and into a new job: `atlantis-dispatch` with `needs: matrix` plus the concurrency group. I'll ping @Alex for review and add a short test PR to verify single plan creation.

Jen: If you want me to pair on the PR, I can help add the concurrency block and update the dispatch payload to include `pr_number` field so the infra logs are clearer. :+1:

Sam: Perfect. Creating PR now and will include the small workflow snippet. Will also add regression test to ensure only one atlantis plan appears for a sample PR. Thanks everyone!
